newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: DIRBTINIS SEES 1997 PROFIT SIX MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: DIRBTINIS SEES 1997 PROFIT SIX MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuanian acetite yarn producer Dirbtinis Pluoshtas plans a six million litas profit in 1997, a company official said on Wednesday.
"We plan a six million litas profit for 1997 and the results of three months work show that this plan is realistic," company official Benjamina Jakavichiene told Reuters.
The company reported that its net profit in 1996 rose to 4.1 million litas versus 3.5 million litas a year ago.
The company also said its turnover in 1996 was 204.8 million litas versus 135.9 million litas a year ago.
It also said its gross profit was 16.8 million litas and operation profit was 6.1 million litas last year.

"The board of the company plans to suggest to leave the profit within the company to develop its production lines but the final decision will be taken during the shareholder's meeting on March 28," Jakavichiene said.
Dirbtinis Pluoshtas exports 80.5 percent of its production to Western Europe, South Korea and Thailand mainly, Jakavichiene added.
The company is quoted on the stock exchange's A list.
